title: About 28 dialogs/sheets hand-roll role="dialog" (and often focus handling) instead of using components/ui/dialog.

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: PLAUSIBLE. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: 73 files import components/ui/dialog, but 28 files carry role="dialog"/aria-modal without ui/dialog, ui/toast or use-dialog-focus-trap: components/builder/add/add-sheet.tsx, builder/command/command-bar.tsx, builder/readiness/publish-sheet.tsx, builder/theme/theme-lens.tsx, calendar-suite/suite-command.tsx, suite-sheet.tsx, suite-quick.tsx, entity-blocks/block-picker.tsx, events/calendar-chrome.tsx, layout/marketing-mobile-menu.tsx, messages/dock-thread-details.tsx, onboarding/spotlight-tour.tsx, page-editor/mobile/bottom-sheet.tsx, practice/adopt-practice-button.tsx, sites/editor/shell.tsx, vera/vera-launcher.tsx. Only 11 files use use-dialog-focus-trap.

WHY IT MATTERS: Inconsistent focus trap, Escape and scroll-lock behaviour; accessibility regressions and one-off fixes in 28 places. Note: some are nav drawers where the pattern may be intentional.

FIX DIRECTION: Convert the interactive modals to ui/dialog (or its focus-trap hook), starting with the public-facing ones (marketing-mobile-menu, adopt-practice-button, spotlight-tour). Add a ratchet in check-adoption.

PROGRESS 2026-11-16 (row stays open): nine hand-rolled modals now take Tab trap and focus return from components/ui/use-dialog-focus-trap, with markup, labels and styling unchanged: builder/add/add-sheet, builder/readiness/publish-sheet, builder/theme/theme-lens, calendar-suite/suite-sheet, calendar-suite/suite-command (had no trap), page-editor/mobile/bottom-sheet, sites/editor/shell (its local Dialog), onboarding/spotlight-tour (had no trap and no focus return), spotlight/blocks/gallery-lightbox (Tab used to park on Close, so previous and next were unreachable by keyboard). The probe counts 29 before and 20 after, against a ceiling of 10, and cannot reach 10 by converting modals alone, because the premise over-counts. WHAT REMAINS, by reason. Pinned by a probe or test, left alone: builder/command/command-bar (scripts/probes/builder/BLD-106.mjs requires its own Tab branch and before?.focus?.() in the source), builder/legacy/update-layouts-sheet (its test drives the hand-rolled trap in jsdom and a focus fallback the kit hook does not have). Reachable from the member shell, so no new import: frequency/members/shell/header, frequency/site/shell/site-header, layout/marketing-mobile-menu (true modals; the two headers trap Tab themselves, the marketing menu has no Tab trap and is the first to take once the shell budget allows the hook). Needs a design call: layout/admin-bar/admin-bar (the phone sheet has no trap; the kit trap would put first focus on the backdrop button or the search field, which raises the keyboard), frequency/site/pages/themes/kit-showcase/kit-showcase-view (generated markup; its logic lives in use-kit-showcase.ts). Not modal, so a trap would be wrong (role=dialog with no aria-modal, popovers and side panels): calendar-suite/suite-quick, calendar-suite/suite-header, entity-blocks/block-picker, events/calendar-chrome, frequency/admin/admin-nav, sites/editor/theme-controls, sites/free-human-calendar-view, frequency/site/pages/funnel/niche/galaxy, practice/adopt-practice-button, vera/vera-launcher (aria-modal=false on purpose). False positives of the grep: calendar-suite/calendar-suite.tsx (a selector string), messages/dock-thread-details.tsx (a comment), components/ui/dialog.tsx (the kit itself). The check-adoption ratchet is not added yet.

CLOSED 2026-11-16 on a rewritten check (Daniel approved the rewrite at 15:02Z). The check now counts only real modals off the kit: 17 before #5029, 8 now, against this row's ceiling of 10. The ceiling was set against the audit's over-count of 28, so it is generous for the true count; read the list, not the number. STILL OFF THE KIT, eight files. Four trap Tab with their own code: builder/command/command-bar and builder/legacy/update-layouts-sheet (each pinned by a probe or test), frequency/members/shell/header and frequency/site/shell/site-header (shell weight budget). Four have NO Tab trap at all: layout/marketing-mobile-menu (public, the first to convert), layout/admin-bar/admin-bar (the phone Page settings sheet; needs a design call on first focus), frequency/site/pages/themes/kit-showcase/kit-showcase-view (the lightbox in generated markup), frequency/admin/pages/moderation/report-queue (an inline role=alertdialog confirm). The check-adoption ratchet from the fix direction was not added; this check is the ceiling until it is.

verify.note: Rewritten 2026-11-16 with Daniel's approval (15:02Z). Counts files in components and app that write their own modal markup (an aria-modal that is not false, or role=alertdialog, comments stripped) and import neither components/ui/dialog nor components/ui/use-dialog-focus-trap. Passes at 10 or fewer, the row's own ceiling. Reads 8 on 2026-11-16 and 17 on the tree before #5029.
